answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The tundra panel is drawn blind, the trellis escrow settles at close, and pulse lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 5% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 180 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
